full_judgment: (I) Total non-cooperation of the respondent Nos. 4 and 6 to undergo DNA Paternity Test. Therefore, the presumption will be that had there been DNA paternity test, it would have been proved that respondent Nos. 4 and 6 are not the parents of the seven children.
